sources.ref: Moondrop Custom EQ web app 1.8.0 build 26B1107 (https://hub.moondroplab.com/), bundle assets/index-iHwVcdAT.js: device table, Old Fashioned config

meta.notes: What Moondrop's Custom EQ web app does with it: it identifies the device by USB vendor id 0x35d8 and product id only, and gives it 5 peaking bands, 20 to 20000 Hz in whole Hz, gain -12 to +3 dB in steps of 0.1 and Q 0.1 to 10 in steps of 0.01, with no pre-gain. These are the app's editor limits, not verified firmware limits. devicePEQ differs in Q step (0.001) and was seeded by scripts/import/seed.ts; the name-based entries come from it.
